evidence_description: States Google Street View used as base reference but on-site shooting needed for details/angles; aerial photography or original architectural drawings (平立剖) used for inaccessible angles; large-scale Photoshop photo collaging and rough sketching to simplify buildings.

States explicit pipeline: PS photo base -> sketch tracing -> line cleanup -> AI vector drawing -> color blocking -> PS refinement -> multi-size adaptation; throughput ~10 illustrations/month (~3 days each); 2-3 discarded drafts, some full redraws.

States each image required significant background/scenery repositioning and supplemental painting to adapt to postcard/phone case/badge/magnet aspect ratios; the Engineering Building illustration cited as undergoing near-total compositional rearrangement.

States packaging/unboxing research; factory MOQ of ~10,000 units vs. actual need of ~500; custom stamp made for on-demand logo application; boxes hand-folded; kraft paper + plastic bag layering for protection.
States each product tested with 3-5 manufacturers, evaluated on color accuracy (色差), price, and packaging specification.

States review of Singapore Trade Mark Act and Copyright Act, multiple lawyer consultations; constraint that university logos/registered trademarked names could never appear on products or packaging; some buildings have asserted architectural/portrait rights and were excluded from illustration.

States rejection of low-price/high-volume strategy; pricing set to Singapore market/student buyer persona (postcard ~$1 SGD, magnet ~$4 SGD, mug ~$12 SGD); 7-8% bundle discount; tiered spend promotions ($10/$20/$35 SGD thresholds).

States initial inadequate QC caused product variation; specific defect categories for sphere magnets (weight/height/position, glass damage) and phone cases (print shadowing/misaligned cuts); refunds processed for defective units; described as the designer's largest source of loss.
States ~100+ product variants; designer set up a simple in-house photo studio for product photography.

States promotion began only after inventory received; pre-launch prep included ~200 promotional/detail-page images across platforms, delivery-team coordination on handoff logistics, and full listing setup.

States campus food-delivery app as primary channel; concern over oil contamination/crushing led to multi-layer protective packaging (kraft paper bag inside plastic bag) per pickup point; Excel-formatted printed labels.

States sole-operator duties: backend listing edits/verification, order intake, customer service, inventory management, fulfillment, delivery coordination, after-sales, financial reporting, profit calculation.
